items.claim: Adobe describes Spectrum 2 as more expressive, approachable, inclusive, and accessible while remaining at home across platforms.
Spectrum 2 updates include brighter color, thicker and more rounded icons, refreshed typography, and a more expressive visual language.
Adobe describes color, contrast, scale, and contextual flexibility as tools for inclusive and accessible product experiences.
items.notes: Claim narrowed to the current official Spectrum 2 source.

items.claim: The transferable lesson is expressive control: visual personality can increase when hierarchy and accessibility rules become more deliberate, not less.
